Santa Rosa County is a county in Florida, the United States. The population in Santa Rosa County was 211,115 in 2025. The median age in Santa Rosa County was 40.1 in 2024. The median income in Santa Rosa County was $42,683 in 2024. The unemployment rate in Santa Rosa County was 5% in 2026. The percentage of people with obesity in Santa Rosa County was 31.1% in 2022. Santa Rosa County is a county in Florida, the United States. The population in Santa Rosa County was 211,115 in 2025. The median age in Santa Rosa County was 40.1 in 2024. Summary

Gulf Breeze is a city in Florida, the United States. The population in Gulf Breeze was 7,067 in 2025. The median age in Gulf Breeze was 49.9 in 2024. The median income in Gulf Breeze was $48,675 in 2024. The percentage of people with obesity in Gulf Breeze was 29.1% in 2022. The percentage of people who binge drink in Gulf Breeze was 20.5% in 2022. The percentage of people who smoke in Gulf Breeze was 12.7% in 2022.

Summary

Milton is a city in Florida, the United States. The population in Milton was 11,440 in 2025. The median age in Milton was 38.4 in 2024. The median income in Milton was $42,037 in 2024. The percentage of people with obesity in Milton was 35.5% in 2022. The percentage of people who binge drink in Milton was 17.7% in 2022. The percentage of people who smoke in Milton was 20.8% in 2022.

**Santa Rosa County’s five most populous cities (per Data Commons)**  
1. Navarre – 39,838 (2024) – population source: Data Commons place geoId/1248050【Page note: https://datacommons.org/place/geoId/1248050】  
2. Pace – 26,334 (2024) – population from the same Data Commons place page for Pace (geoId/1246601)【Page note: https://datacommons.org/place/geoId/1246601】  
3. Midway – 21,316 (2024) – population in the Data Commons page for Midway (geoId/1245465)【Page note: https://datacommons.org/place/geoId/1245465】  
4. Milton – 11,440 (2025) – population from Data Commons (geoId/1245750)【Page note: https://datacommons.org/place/geoId/1245750】  
5. Gulf Breeze – 7,067 (2025) – population from Data Commons (geoId/1228000)【Page note: https://datacommons.org/place/geoId/1228000】

**Median value of owner‑occupied housing units (2019‑2023; census.gov)**  
* The series “Median value of owner‑occupied housing units, 2020‑2024” is reported in QuickFacts and ACS 5‑year tables.  
* All five cities have median values above $200 000:

| City | Median value (2020‑2024) | Source |
|------|--------------------|--------|
| Navarre | $375,700 | U.S. Census QuickFacts: Navarre CDP Florida (2020‑2024)【Page note: https://www.census.gov/quickfacts/fact/table/navarrecdpflorida】 |
| Pace | $293,800 | U.S. Census QuickFacts: Pace CDP Florida (2020‑2024)【Page note: https://www.census.gov/quickfacts/fact/table/pacecdpflorida】 |
| Midway | $381,600 | U.S. Census QuickFacts: Midway CDP Florida (2020‑2024)【Page note: https://www.census.gov/quickfacts/fact/table/midwaycdpflorida/DP1】 |
| Milton | $322,900 | U.S. Census QuickFacts: Milton Go County city Florida (2020‑2024)【Page note: https://www.census.gov/quickfacts/fact/table/miltonflorida】 |
| Gulf Breeze | $267,900 | U.S. Census QuickFacts: Gulf Breeze CDP Florida (2020‑2024)【Page note: https://www.census.gov/quickfacts/fact/table/gulfbreezecdpflorida】 |

**Answer (ordered by greatest to least median value)**  

| Rank | City | Median owner‑occupied housing unit value (2019‑2023) |
|------|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| 1 | Midway | $381,600 |
| 2 | Navarre | $375,700 |
| 3 | Milton | $322,900 |
| 4 | Pace | $293,800 |
| 5 | Gulf Breeze | $267,900 |

All five cities thus satisfy the criterion of having a median owner‑occupied housing‑unit value above $200 000.
